routing.entryResolution: Role-specific proof-bound resolver supplied by integration owner; explicit stageCodePointers describe actual backend function cells. No address-named forwarding or application-body call scripting.
routing.emittedCodePointers: Every constructor-emitted method cell has both a stageCodePointers binding and a stageFinal word containing its original stock entry. Expected owned words are substituted by declared role before execution; observations are not normalized.

boundaries.source: Original signed divide/remainder zero path reaches SVC 1010 and does not return.
boundaries.missingDeviceLaw: Terminal kernel exception effects and any external observer are unqualified. No finite fallback return is modeled.

boundaries.location: Font heap reclaimer hook at heap+0x24, user data +0x28, depth +0x2c
boundaries.normalConstructorInvariant: Owned heap initialization receives a null reclaimer hook. Non-null externally installed hooks retain their original callback ABI and are not claimed as closed application processing.

boundaries.classification: Software state supplied by caller workspace, not a device service.
boundaries.source: Program initializer, render wrapper, and VM handlers do not assign these scale words. Public allocation does not promise zeroed reused storage. Physical adapter preserves actual words.
boundaries.restriction: No zero/2048 producer or arbitrary legacy workspace equivalence is claimed. Portable outline initialization is explicit typed software state.

genuineFragment.evidence: Captured resource bytes, directory entry, glyph program and property bytes; source-derived 81-word outline expectation. No native observation claimed.

incorrectControlWitnesses: Corrupted glyph program fails without cache but cached pixels bypass that program.
Insufficient output capacity preserves partial contour output and returns the original error.
Zero-count unaligned fill still changes the alignment prefix.
Reallocation copies requested new byte count and releases the original allocation.

portableCore.asset: Borrowed validated FDL/BDF/DCW resources, no absolute physical address in core.
portableCore.workspace: Caller-owned typed state and borrowed output bytes, allocation-free.
portableCore.renderRoute: FDL uses actual requested-dimension RasterVM through raster::render_glyph, not a lossy normalized outline intermediate. BDF and DCW use actual shared bitmap parser/decoder.
portableCore.glyphMask: Sealed borrowed coverage with read-only getters, checked last-row span, signed baseline-relative bearings and advances. Public construction validates active Gray4 bytes; actual renderer producers avoid a redundant range scan. PackedMsb1 is MSB first; Gray4 is one 0..15 byte per pixel; Gray8 is one 0..255 byte per pixel.
portableCore.integrationStatus: Separate assigned backend modules and Graphics consumer must land before a coherent aggregate checkpoint can be admitted.
